title: Nordic Animals In Motion
wikitext:
Started out with [[Rikoll]] and [[Trygve]] as a [[2on2]]-team in [[NNQL]]. In late [[2007|'07]], Naim was joined by [[Arnette]], who had recently returned to QuakeWorld after about two years of absence. Subsequently, Naim decided to form a clan for [[NQR Season 11|NQR11]]. With [[Votary]] and [[Overdose]] having left [[EnemyQuad]], [[IgggY]] and [[Antic]] no longer had a full team to participate in NQR11, resulting in their recruitment to Naim. The clan brought back numerous Norwegian quake players.

The clan was merged with [[The Axemen]] in December 2008.
